definition: Geometric chain using lagged-year partner weights.

weights: Mean of current and previous years

label: Direct current-weighted index
definition: 100 × exp(sum_i w(i,t) × [ln z(i,t) − ln z(i,1929)]), where z=e for NEER and z=q for REER. Direct aggregation of bilateral relatives to 1929; supplied for total trade only.
relative_price_interpretation: Real/nominal ratio; annual residual may include reweighting
